blurb: Guests join fishing charters targeting a variety of species including redfish, flounder, speckled trout, black drum, sheepshead, Spanish mackerel, king mackerel, and various sharks. Trips include inshore shallow water fishing and nearshore/offshore deeper water fishing. Fishing licenses are provided by the charter captains, and guests may keep fish within state size and bag limits.
